name: MDM4 regulator of p53
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MDM4 encodes protein Mdm4. Annotated molecular activities include enzyme activator activity and zinc ion binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include YAP1::KMT2A-rearranged sarcoma; Neuroendocrine carcinoma of breast. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
